subject: DI04019011

h.en: 4.1.1 A boiler is a pressure system, not only a heater
h.gu: 4.1.1 Boiler ફક્ત Heater નહિ,Pressure System છે

body.en:
Start with the situation

A process needs steam at a specified pressure, quality and rate. Fuel input alone does not tell us whether the boiler is safe or efficient.

Definition / principle

A steam generator transfers heat to water to produce steam for use; its complete system includes pressure parts, combustion/heat source, water treatment, controls and protection.

Understand why

Trace three paths:water/steam, fuel/air/flue gas and control/protection. Missing any path makes a construction answer incomplete.

Application / illustration

Textile, food, pharma and process plants use rated steam for heating and other duties.

Common mistake / conditions

No lesson here authorises boiler operation, repair, pressure testing or bypassing a protective device.

Are feed check and steam stop the same valve?

No. They serve feedwater entry/backflow prevention and steam-outlet isolation/control respectively.
body.gu:
પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત

Processને specified pressure,quality,rateનું steam જોઈએ.ફક્ત fuel inputથી boiler safe/efficient છે કે નહિ જાણી ન શકાય.

Definition / Principle

Steam generator waterને heat આપીને ઉપયોગ માટે steam બનાવે;complete systemમાં pressure parts,combustion/heat source,water treatment,controls,protection આવે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

ત્રણ paths trace કરો:water/steam,fuel/air/flue gas,control/protection.એક પણ છોડીએ તો construction answer અધૂરો.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

Textile,food,pharma,process plants rated steam heating/બીજા duties માટે વાપરે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

આ lesson boiler operation,repair,pressure testing કે protective bypass કરવાની permission નથી.

Feed Check અને Steam Stop Same Valve?

ના.તે અનુક્રમે feedwater entry/backflow prevention અને steam-outlet isolation/control કરે.

h.en: 4.1.2 IBR context and the legal definition

body.en:
Definition / principle

IBR refers to Indian Boiler Regulations. The legal definition and application also depend on the governing Boilers Act; do not treat a classroom shorthand as a compliance decision.

Understand why

The Boilers Act2025, section2(c), describes a pressure vessel in which steam is generated for external use by heat, wholly or partly under pressure when steam is shut off. [1]

Its definition excludes a vessel below25litres(measured feed check valve to main steam stop valve), or below1kg/cm² in both design and working gauge pressure, or heating water below100°C; read the complete Act and applicable regulations for actual coverage. [1]

Common mistake / conditions

Quote the applicable edition/date in an exam or compliance record; older textbook wording may differ. Registration, inspection and qualified-authority requirements must not be inferred from a simplified numerical example.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

IBR એટલે Indian Boiler Regulations.Legal definition,application governing Boilers Act પર પણ આધારિત છે;classroom shorthandને compliance decision ન માનો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Boilers Act2025,section2(c)માં heatથી external use માટે steam બને,steam shut off થાય ત્યારે wholly/partly pressure હેઠળ રહે તે pressure vesselનું વર્ણન છે. [1]

Definitionમાં25litresથી ઓછી capacity(feed check valveથી main steam stop valve),અથવા design અને working gauge pressure બન્ને1kg/cm²થી ઓછાં,અથવા water100°Cથી નીચે ગરમ કરતું vessel exclude થાય;actual coverage માટે complete Act,applicable regulations વાંચો. [1]

Common Mistake / શરતો

Exam/compliance recordમાં applicable edition/date લખો;જૂના textbookનું wording જુદું હોઈ શકે.Registration,inspection,qualified-authority requirements simple numericalથી ન કાઢો.

body.en:
Understand why

Fire-tube:hot gases inside tubes, water around them. Water-tube:water/steam inside tubes, hot gases outside. Combined designs use both arrangements in specified parts.

Also classify by pressure, duty, orientation, fuel/heat source, circulation(natural/forced) and erection(packaged/site-assembled).A packaged boiler is factory-integrated to a specified extent, not a separate thermodynamic law.

Select steam rate, pressure, quality, load response, available fuel/waste heat, water quality, emissions, space, maintenance and legal/rated requirements.

Common mistake / conditions

A small water inventory can respond rapidly but also needs reliable control; one construction family is not universally best.

Can efficiency values onHHV andLHV be compared directly?

Not fairly without converting to a common calorific basis and boundary.
body.gu:
કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Fire-tubeમાં hot gases tubesની અંદર,water બહાર.Water-tubeમાં water/steam tubesની અંદર,hot gases બહાર.Combinedમાં specified partsમાં બન્ને arrangements હોય.

Pressure,duty,orientation,fuel/heat source,circulation(natural/forced),erection(packaged/site-assembled)થી પણ classify કરો.Packaged boiler specified extent સુધી factory-integrated હોય,અલગ thermodynamic law નહિ.

Steam rate,pressure,quality,load response,fuel/waste heat,water quality,emissions,space,maintenance,legal/rated requirementsથી selection કરો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

નાનું water inventory ઝડપથી respond કરે,પણ reliable control જોઈએ;એક family હંમેશાં best નથી.

HHV,LHVની Efficiency સીધી Compare થાય?

Common calorific basis,boundary વગર fair comparison નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A burner heats a furnace/gas-pass tube arrangement surrounded by water in a pressure shell.

Construction:part and purpose

A pressure shell holds water and steam space.

Furnace and fire tubes carry hot combustion gases.

Burner, fan, fuel controls and refractory as designed sustain combustion.

Tube sheets/turnaround chambers direct the specified gas passes.

Feedwater connection, mountings and protective controls complete the rated package.

Working:flow and reason

Treated feedwater enters through the controlled feed system.

Burner releases heat into the furnace under authorised interlocked control.

Hot gas travels through the designed passes and transfers heat through tube walls.

Water heats/boils; steam separates into the steam space.

Steam leaves through the controlled outlet; gas leaves to heat recovery/stack as designed.

Common mistake / conditions

Do not reverse the gas/water labels or confuse a burner with a safety valve. Low-water and combustion safety require qualified systems.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Burner furnace/gas-pass tubes ગરમ કરે;pressure shellમાં water તેને ઘેરે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Pressure shell water,steam space ધરાવે.

Furnace,fire tubes hot gases લઈ જાય.

Designed burner,fan,fuel controls,refractory combustion જાળવે.

Tube sheets/turnaround chambers specified gas passes આપે.

Feedwater connection,mountings,protective controls rated package પૂરી કરે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Treated feedwater controlled feed systemથી આવે.

Authorised interlocked controlમાં burner furnaceમાં heat આપે.

Hot gas designed passesમાં tube wallsથી heat આપે.

Water heat/boil થાય;steam steam spaceમાં separate થાય.

Steam controlled outletથી જાય;gas designed recovery/stackમાં જાય.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Gas/water labels ઊલટાં ન કરો,burnerને safety valve ન માનો.Low-water,combustion safety માટે qualified systems જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Water/steam flows inside tubes exposed to hot gases; drums/headers separate and distribute the working fluid as designed.

Construction:part and purpose

Water/steam drums or headers connect tube circuits.

Heated riser tubes/water walls receive furnace heat.

Downcomers/circulation system supply denser water to heated circuits.

Furnace, burner and gas ducting provide the heat path.

Steam separation, superheater if fitted, mountings and feed controls support rated output.

Working:flow and reason

Feedwater enters the designated drum/header circuit.

Circulation moves water through heated tubes.

Boiling produces a water–steam mixture in heated regions.

Separation returns water to circulation and directs steam to outlet/superheater.

Gas transfers heat successively through furnace and any recovery surfaces before exhaust.

Common mistake / conditions

Natural circulation relies on density/head differences; forced-circulation designs use a pump. Do not assume all tube circuits have the same flow arrangement.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Water/steam tubesની અંદર,hot gases બહાર;designed drums/headers fluid distribute/separate કરે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Water/steam drums/headers tube circuits જોડે.

Heated riser tubes/water walls furnace heat લે.

Downcomers/circulation denser waterને heated circuits આપે.

Furnace,burner,gas ducting heat path આપે.

Steam separation,fitted superheater,mountings,feed controls rated output આપે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Feedwater designated drum/headerમાં આવે.

Circulation waterને heated tubesમાં લઈ જાય.

Heated regionsમાં boilingથી water–steam mixture બને.

Separation waterને circulationમાં,steamને outlet/superheaterમાં મોકલે.

Gas furnace,recovery surfacesમાં heat આપી exhaust થાય.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Natural circulation density/head differenceથી;forcedમાં pumpથી.બધા tube circuits same flow arrangement ધરાવે એમ ન માનો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A specified package combines water-tube and fire-tube heat-transfer sections in one integrated arrangement.

Construction:part and purpose

A water-tube/furnace section handles its assigned high-heat region.

A fire-tube section receives the specified downstream gas flow.

Headers/shell and fluid connections integrate water/steam circuits.

Common combustion, feed, protection and gas-recovery controls complete the design.

Working:flow and reason

Trace treated water and circulation through the actual package drawing.

Follow hot gas through the water-tube and fire-tube sections in the specified order.

Heat is transferred to the associated water/steam circuits without intended gas mixing.

Steam separates and exits through rated controls while gas exhausts through the designated path.

Common mistake / conditions

There is no single universal combined-boiler layout; label the illustrated generic arrangement and consult the specific manufacturer drawing for an actual unit.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Specified packageમાં water-tube,fire-tube heat-transfer sections integrated હોય.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Water-tube/furnace section assigned high-heat region લે.

Fire-tube section specified downstream gas flow લે.

Headers/shell,fluid connections water/steam circuits જોડે.

Common combustion,feed,protection,gas-recovery controls design પૂરું કરે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Actual package drawingમાં treated water,circulation trace કરો.

Specified orderમાં hot gasને water-tube,fire-tube sectionsમાં trace કરો.

Intended gas mixing વગર associated water/steam circuitsમાં heat જાય.

Steam separate થઈ rated controlsથી,gas designated pathથી જાય.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Combined boilerનું એક universal layout નથી;illustrated generic arrangement label કરો,actual unit માટે manufacturer drawing જુઓ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A waste-heat boiler generates steam using available hot process/exhaust gas; additional firing is present only where specifically designed.

Construction:part and purpose

An inlet duct receives a characterised hot-gas stream.

Evaporator/tube surfaces transfer heat to water/steam.

Drum/headers, circulation and separation manage steam generation.

Economiser/superheater, bypass or supplementary firing may be provided by design.

Controls protect against gas/steam-side limits and source fluctuations.

Working:flow and reason

Hot source gas enters the designated heat-recovery path.

Feedwater is preheated if an economiser is installed.

Evaporator heat generates steam; separation/circulation continue as designed.

Recovered heat lowers exhaust temperature subject to corrosion/dewpoint/process limits.

Steam is delivered at rated conditions; controls respond to variable source duty.

Common mistake / conditions

Waste heat is not unlimited or automatically zero-cost; back-pressure, source availability, corrosion and fouling constrain recovery.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Waste-heat boiler available hot process/exhaust gasથી steam બનાવે;additional firing specified designમાં જ હોય.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Inlet duct characterised hot-gas stream લે.

Evaporator/tubes water/steamમાં heat આપે.

Drum/headers,circulation,separation steam generation સંભાળે.

Design મુજબ economiser/superheater,bypass,supplementary firing હોઈ શકે.

Controls gas/steam limits,source fluctuations સામે protect કરે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Hot source gas designated recovery pathમાં આવે.

Economiser હોય તો feedwater preheat થાય.

Evaporator heatથી steam બને;designed separation/circulation ચાલે.

Corrosion/dewpoint/process limitsમાં exhaust temperature ઘટે.

Rated conditionsનું steam મળે;controls variable source dutyને respond કરે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Waste heat unlimited/automatically zero-cost નથી;back-pressure,availability,corrosion,fouling limits છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Upward air supports and mixes a bed of solids so fuel burns in an intensely mixed bed; heat is transferred to water/steam surfaces.

Construction:part and purpose

A distributor supplies air below the solid bed.

Bed material, fuel feed and optional sorbent support the intended combustion chemistry.

Furnace and heat-transfer tubes/walls absorb heat.

Ash handling, air fans and gas cleaning manage residual solids/emissions.

Circulating-bed variants add a separator/cyclone and solids return.

Working:flow and reason

Distributed air fluidises the bed within its designed operating range.

Fuel mixes with hot solids and burns with controlled air supply.

Bed mixing promotes heat transfer and more uniform temperature than many fixed-bed arrangements.

Heat surfaces generate steam; gas/solids follow designed separation/cleaning paths.

Ash and any sorbent products are removed through rated systems.

Common mistake / conditions

Benefits can include fuel flexibility and controlled combustion temperature, but erosion, bed agglomeration, particulates, fan power and emissions still require design/control.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Upward air solidsના bedને support/mix કરે,એમાં fuel burn થાય;heat water/steam surfacesમાં જાય.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Distributor solid bedની નીચેથી air આપે.

Bed material,fuel feed,optional sorbent intended chemistry આપે.

Furnace,heat-transfer tubes/walls heat લે.

Ash handling,air fans,gas cleaning solids/emissions સંભાળે.

Circulating-bed variantsમાં separator/cyclone,solids return હોય.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Designed rangeમાં distributed air bed fluidise કરે.

Fuel hot solids સાથે mix થઈ controlled airમાં burn થાય.

Bed mixing heat transfer,અનેક fixed-bed કરતાં uniform temperature આપે.

Heat surfaces steam બનાવે;gas/solids designed separation/cleaningમાં જાય.

Ash,sorbent products rated systemsથી દૂર થાય.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Fuel flexibility,controlled temperature લાભ હોઈ શકે,પણ erosion,agglomeration,particulates,fan power,emissions માટે design/control જોઈએ.

h.gu: 4.2.1 Draftથી Air અને Flue Gas ખસે

body.en:
Definition / principle

Boiler draft is the pressure difference that drives combustion air and flue gas through the system against flow resistance.

Understand why

Natural draft arises from density difference between hot chimney gas and ambient air. For a simplified uniform-density heightH:Delta p≈gH(rho air−rho gas).

Forced draft(FD) fan supplies air upstream; induced draft(ID) fan draws gas downstream; balanced draft uses coordinated FD/ID to maintain specified furnace pressure.

Common mistake / conditions

Fan position determines the classification, not just the direction of an arrow. Never bypass furnace-pressure or combustion interlocks.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Boiler draft combustion air,flue gasને systemના flow resistance સામે ખસેડતો pressure difference છે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Natural draft hot chimney gas,ambient airની density differenceથી બને.Simplified uniform-density height Hમાં Delta p≈gH(rho air−rho gas).

Forced draft(FD) upstream air આપે;induced draft(ID) downstream gas ખેંચે;balanced draft coordinated FD/IDથી specified furnace pressure રાખે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Classification fan positionથી,ફક્ત arrow directionથી નહિ.Furnace-pressure,combustion interlocks bypass ન કરો.

body.en:
Understand why

Safety valve:relieves excessive pressure; located on the specified boiler steam/pressure space connection, not an ordinary operator throttling valve.

Pressure gauge:indicates pressure from the designated pressure/steam connection with suitable protective arrangement. Water-level indicator:shows water level through appropriate steam/water connections.

Steam stop valve:isolates/controls the steam outlet at the designated outlet connection. Feed check valve:controls feed entry and prevents reverse flow at the feedwater inlet.

Blowdown valve/system:removes concentrated boiler water/sludge from its specified lower connection under a controlled procedure. Inspection openings permit authorised examination when safely isolated.

Common mistake / conditions

Exact number, location, capacity and interlocks depend on the approved boiler design/regulations; this is function/location learning, not installation specification.
body.gu:
કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Safety valve excessive pressure relieve કરે;specified steam/pressure space connection પર હોય,ordinary throttling valve નહિ.

Pressure gauge designated pressure/steam connectionથી protective arrangement સાથે pressure બતાવે.Water-level indicator યોગ્ય steam/water connectionsથી level બતાવે.

Steam stop valve designated steam outlet isolate/control કરે.Feed check valve feedwater inlet પર entry control,reverse flow અટકાવે.

Blowdown system specified lower connectionથી concentrated water/sludge controlled procedureમાં કાઢે.Inspection openings safely isolated conditionમાં authorised examination આપે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Exact number,location,capacity,interlocks approved design/regulations પર આધારિત;આ function/location learning છે,installation specification નહિ.

h.en: 4.2.3 Low-water protection and fusible plug context

body.en:
Understand why

Low-water protection senses unsafe level and initiates the specified protective action; it is distinct from merely displaying level. Flame safeguards, fuel isolation and pressure/temperature trips support the complete safety system.

A fusible plug in traditional suitable boiler designs uses a low-melting insert at a specified heated plate location intended to respond to overheating due to low water. It is not universal to all modern boilers.

Common mistake / conditions

Never claim a fusible plug replaces certified controls or guarantees prevention of an explosion. Do not test protection by deliberately creating a low-water condition.
body.gu:
કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Low-water protection unsafe level sense કરી specified protective action આપે;ફક્ત level displayથી જુદું.Flame safeguards,fuel isolation,pressure/temperature trips complete safetyને ટેકો આપે.

Traditional suitable boilerમાં specified heated plate locationનો low-melting insertવાળો fusible plug low-water overheatingને respond કરવા હોય.બધા modern boilersમાં universal નથી.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Fusible plug certified controlsની જગ્યા લે કે explosion હંમેશાં અટકાવે એવો દાવો નહિ.જાણબૂઝી low-water condition બનાવી protection test ન કરો.

h.en: 4.2.4 Accessories:recover heat and improve steam supply

body.en:
Understand why

Economiser:preheats feedwater using exhaust-gas heat, usually in the downstream gas path before the stack. Air preheater:transfers gas heat to combustion air before burner/furnace entry.

Superheater:raises dry steam temperature above saturation using suitable hot-gas surfaces. Steam separator:removes entrained liquid in the steam path; steam trap:discharges condensate/air with controlled steam loss in the appropriate condensate system.

Feed pump delivers water above the required inlet pressure; deaeration/water-treatment equipment controls gases/chemistry within its design.

Common mistake / conditions

Traditional mounting/accessory labels are teaching categories, not a reason to treat an “accessory” as dispensable when the approved plant design requires it.
body.gu:
કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Economiser exhaust-gas heatથી feedwater preheat કરે,સામાન્ય રીતે downstream gas pathમાં stack પહેલાં.Air preheater gas heat combustion airને burner/furnace પહેલાં આપે.

Superheater hot-gas surfacesથી dry steamને saturationથી ઉપર ગરમ કરે.Steam separator steam pathમાંથી liquid કાઢે;steam trap appropriate condensate systemમાં controlled steam loss સાથે condensate/air કાઢે.

Feed pump required inlet pressureથી ઉપર water આપે;deaeration/water-treatment designed gases/chemistry control કરે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Traditional mounting/accessory labels teaching categories છે;approved plantને જરૂરી “accessory” કાઢી શકાય એવો અર્થ નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Actual evaporation is steam generated per time or per mass fuel, with its stated feed/steam conditions. Equivalent evaporation converts useful duty to evaporation from saturated water at100°C to dry saturated steam at100°C.

Understand why

Using conventional latent reference2257kJ/kg:factor of evaporation=(hsteam−hfeed)/2257; equivalent rate=mdot steam×factor. Equivalentkg/kg fuel=(ms/mf)(hs−hfw)/2257.

Common mistake / conditions

Use actual steam enthalpy:wet, saturated or superheated as appropriate. Factor of evaporation is not boiler efficiency.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Actual evaporation stated feed/steam conditionsમાં time દીઠ કે fuel mass દીઠ generated steam છે.Equivalent evaporation useful dutyને100°C saturated waterથી100°C dry saturated steamના equivalentમાં ફેરવે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Conventional latent reference2257kJ/kgમાં factor of evaporation=(hsteam−hfeed)/2257;equivalent rate=mdot steam×factor.Equivalent kg/kg fuel=(ms/mf)(hs−hfw)/2257.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Actual steam enthalpy wet/saturated/superheated પ્રમાણે લો.Factor of evaporation boiler efficiency નથી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Direct efficiencyeta=mdot steam(hsteam−hfeed)/(mdot fuel×CV) on a stated consistent calorific-value basis. Boiler thermal output is useful steam-duty rate inkW.

Understand why

Boiler horsepower(BHP) is a historical rating:oneBHP≈9.81kW thermal, about15.65kg/h equivalent evaporation. Do not confuse boiler horsepower with shaft/mechanical horsepower.

Common mistake / conditions

StateHHV/GCV orLHV/NCV and system boundary; efficiencies cannot be compared fairly if their calorific basis or included losses differ.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Stated consistent calorific-value basis પર direct efficiency eta=mdot steam(hsteam−hfeed)/(mdot fuel×CV).Boiler thermal output useful steam-duty rate kWમાં છે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Boiler horsepower(BHP) historical rating છે:એક BHP≈9.81kW thermal,લગભગ15.65kg/h equivalent evaporation.Boiler horsepowerને shaft/mechanical horsepower ન માનો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

HHV/GCV કે LHV/NCV,system boundary લખો;calorific basis/included losses જુદાં હોય તો efficiency fair રીતે સરખાવી ન શકાય.

body.en:
Given and model

Steam2000kg/h, fuel150kg/h, CV30000kJ/kg; hsteam2800, hfeed200kJ/kg; neglect blowdown in this stated useful-duty calculation.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Useful heat=2000(2800−200)=5200000kJ/h=1444.444kW
  2. Fuel heat=150×30000=4500000kJ/h
  3. These supplied data would giveeta=115.556%, which is physically inconsistent for this fuel-only steady boundary; do not accept the impossible result.
  4. For a corrected illustrative fuel flow200kg/h:input6000000kJ/h, eta86.6667%.
  5. Factor=2600/2257=1.151972; equivalent rate=2303.943kg/h
  6. Equivalent evaporation perkg fuel=2303.943/200=11.5197kg/kg
  7. Thermal boiler horsepower≈1444.444/9.81=147.242BHP

Common mistake / conditions

The first data set is intentionally an error-detection exercise; the corrected calculation explicitly changes only fuel flow, not secretly the steam conditions.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Steam2000kg/h,fuel150kg/h,CV30000kJ/kg;hsteam2800,hfeed200kJ/kg;આ useful-duty calculationમાં blowdown અવગણો.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Useful heat=2000(2800−200)=5200000kJ/h=1444.444kW
  2. Fuel heat=150×30000=4500000kJ/h
  3. આ supplied dataથી eta=115.556% મળે,આ fuel-only steady boundaryમાં physically inconsistent છે;impossible result accept ન કરો.
  4. Corrected illustrative fuel flow200kg/h હોય તો input6000000kJ/h,eta86.6667%.
  5. Factor=2600/2257=1.151972;equivalent rate=2303.943kg/h
  6. Equivalent evaporation perkg fuel=2303.943/200=11.5197kg/kg
  7. Thermal boiler horsepower≈1444.444/9.81=147.242BHP

Common Mistake / શરતો

પહેલો data set ઇરાદાપૂર્વક error-detection exercise છે;correctedમાં ફક્ત fuel flow સ્પષ્ટ બદલે છે,steam conditions ચૂપચાપ નહિ.

h.en: 4.3.4 Heat balance sheet:where did fuel energy go?
h.gu: 4.3.4 Heat Balance Sheet:Fuel Energy ક્યાં ગઈ?

body.en:
Step-by-step solution

  1. Choose basis(perkg fuel or perhour), calorific-value convention and reference temperature.
  2. List fuel input and any separately credited inlet energy exactly once.
  3. Calculate useful steam duty, stack dry-gas loss, water-vapour/moisture losses, unburnt fuel/ash losses, blowdown where included, and radiation/convection/unaccounted losses.
  4. Express every item in the same energy basis and as a percentage of the same input; check totals close with measurement uncertainty.

Common mistake / conditions

An unaccounted residual is not automatically pure radiation loss; it also contains measurement error, missing streams and modelling effects.
body.gu:
Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Basis(per kg fuel/per hour),calorific convention,reference temperature લો.
  2. Fuel input,અલગ credited inlet energy દરેક એક જ વાર લો.
  3. Useful steam duty,stack dry-gas loss,water-vapour/moisture losses,unburnt fuel/ash,સમાવિષ્ટ blowdown,radiation/convection/unaccounted losses ગણો.
  4. દરેક item same energy basis,same inputના percentમાં લખો;measurement uncertainty સાથે totals close થાય તે જુઓ.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Unaccounted residual આપમેળે pure radiation loss નહિ;તેમાં measurement error,missing streams,modelling effects પણ છે.

body.en:
Given and model

Input30000kJ/kg fuel; useful steam24000, dry-gas3000, moisture/vapour1200, unburnt600; remaining residual.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Residual=30000−(24000+3000+1200+600)=1200kJ/kg fuel
  2. Percentages:useful80%, dry gas10%, moisture4%, unburnt2%, residual4%; total100%

Common mistake / conditions

This is an illustrative balance, not claimed industrial test data. Indirect-loss efficiency80% matches useful fraction on the same boundary/basis.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Input30000kJ/kg fuel;useful steam24000,dry-gas3000,moisture/vapour1200,unburnt600;બાકી residual.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Residual=30000−(24000+3000+1200+600)=1200kJ/kg fuel
  2. Percentages:useful80%,dry gas10%,moisture4%,unburnt2%,residual4%;total100%

Common Mistake / શરતો

આ illustrative balance છે,industrial test dataનો દાવો નહિ.Same boundary/basisમાં indirect-loss efficiency80% useful fraction સાથે મળે.

body.en:
Understand why

Maintain correct water chemistry, combustion/excess air, clean heat surfaces, steam traps, insulation and condensate return; recover heat where corrosion/temperature/process limits permit.

Excess air that is too high increases stack losses; too little can cause incomplete combustion and hazardous conditions. Control must use qualified measurements and authorised tuning.

Common mistake / conditions

Do not chase efficiency by defeating minimum safe water level, relief protection, purge requirements or emissions controls.
body.gu:
કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Correct water chemistry,combustion/excess air,clean surfaces,steam traps,insulation,condensate return જાળવો;corrosion/temperature/process limitsમાં heat recover કરો.

વધુ excess airથી stack loss વધે;બહુ ઓછાથી incomplete combustion,hazards થાય.Qualified measurements,authorised tuning જરૂરી.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Efficiency માટે safe water level,relief protection,purge કે emissions controls defeat ન કરો.

h.en: 4.3.7 Exam route and honest practical record
h.gu: 4.3.7 Exam Route અને સાચો Practical Record

body.en:
Write a strong exam answer

  1. Construction:draw water/steam and gas paths separately, label controls, explain the heat-transfer sequence, and identify specific advantages/limits.
  2. Performance:write basis, enthalpies, fuelCV and units; show efficiency, evaporation and heat-balance steps; reject impossible results before interpreting.
  3. Industrial data collection/boiler demonstrations require permission and supervision. No visit, reading sheet or operating certificate is fabricated here.
Does more steam perkg fuel always mean a more efficient boiler?

No. Compare feed/steam enthalpies, fuelCV and identical boundaries, not steam mass alone.
body.gu:
Exam Answer મજબૂત ગોઠવીએ

  1. Constructionમાં water/steam,gas paths અલગ દોરો,controls label કરો,heat-transfer sequence,advantages/limits સમજાવો.
  2. Performanceમાં basis,enthalpies,fuel CV,units લખો;efficiency,evaporation,heat balance steps આપો;અર્થ કરતાં પહેલાં impossible results reject કરો.
  3. Industrial data collection/boiler demonstrationમાં permission,supervision જોઈએ.અહીં visit,reading sheet,operating certificate fabricated નથી.
Fuel દીઠ વધુ Steam એટલે હંમેશાં વધુ Efficient Boiler?

ના.Feed/steam enthalpies,fuel CV,same boundaries સરખાવો,ફક્ત steam mass નહિ.
